what: Eldorado Gold mines and processes gold. It operates mines in Turkey, Greece and Canada, and is building Skouries in northern Greece, a large gold and copper project that will be the biggest single addition to its production.
customers: Refineries and bullion dealers who buy gold at the market price, and smelters who buy copper and zinc concentrate. There are no customer relationships to manage; the product is a commodity.
money: Doré and concentrate from the Turkish, Greek and Canadian mines, sold at spot prices.
Zinc, lead and silver by-products from the Greek operations.
moat: Long-lived ore bodies with permits already in hand. In mining, permitted reserves in reasonably stable jurisdictions are the asset, and Eldorado's Greek and Turkish operations give it decades of production. Skouries adds copper, which widens exposure beyond gold alone.
risks: Free cash flow was about negative $820.1M in the trailing period, because Skouries construction consumes cash before it produces any.
Political and currency risk is concentrated: Turkey has high inflation and a volatile lira, and Greek permitting has historically been contentious.
Large mine construction frequently runs over budget and behind schedule, and Eldorado has little room for either.
Gold prices decide revenue. A fall would hit cash flow while the construction bill still has to be paid.
Debt is about $1.3B against $869.4M of cash.
opportunities: Revenue has grown strongly, from $1.0B in 2023 to $1.8B in 2025, helped by higher gold prices and higher output.
The shares trade at about 9.3 times earnings and 7.3 times EV/EBITDA, a discount to larger gold producers.
Skouries will add meaningful gold and copper production, and copper is in structural demand from electrification.
Six analysts average a $43.50 target against a $26.84 price, reflecting the value they attribute to Skouries once it is running.
watch: Skouries: capital spent, schedule and first production. The current discount exists because the project is unfinished; closing that discount depends entirely on delivering it.
